---
title: "Public Health Data Skills"
---

Welcome to the **St Helena Public Health Data Skills Programme**.

This programme develops practical skills for working with health data in a small-island health system.

The focus is on:

- safe handling of individual-level health data  
- reproducible analytic workflows  
- clear and trustworthy reporting  
- practical decision-support for public health action  

This site section acts as the **living training guide** for the programme.

It contains:

- an overview of the programme
- the module structure
- practical worked examples
- exercises based on real public health tasks

The programme emphasises **doing the work carefully and reproducibly**, using tools that support transparent and auditable analysis.
